digest.component_or_area: LLM structured output parsing and extraction
propositions: Model output must wrap JSON payloads between explicit line-anchored sentinel markers (<<<REBAR_OUTPUT>>> and <<<END>>>) to establish a reliable output channel independent of schema-filtered selection heuristics.

When multiple complete marker blocks are present, extraction must iterate blocks in reverse document order and return the first block whose content validates, with fail-closed semantics if no block validates.
Replies without marker blocks must fall back to the existing schema-filtered full-reply selection pipeline byte-for-byte unchanged, ensuring markerless and legacy transcripts regress.
Marker lines are recognized only when line-anchored (stripped content exactly equals the marker string), preventing collision with JSON string values containing the literal marker text.
The bounded-retry prompt in structured_run.py must name the same markers as the first attempt, so the fail-closed retry channel remains consistent across both attempts.
A marker block with schema-invalid content must raise StructuredOutputError (fail-closed) rather than fall through to select a valid decoy outside the markers.
